g.text: Every placement is an offer with 48 hours to reply. Every exit except accept frees the seat for the next child in lottery order.
Release the seat in ONE transaction
exit marker: a state is left once
Accept and expire are both judged against the transaction's own server time, so exactly one can win. Verified: 500 simultaneous accepts of one offer → 1 changed, the rest
replayed or unchanged; 50 duplicate promotion jobs → exactly 1 promotion.
